items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Charlie was making a tour with Budd Johnson and Oliver Jackson.

ctx.x: I wrote about the time I did the Mildred Bailey radio show and Charlie was in the studio orchestra. But we did actually play together once, and that was at a festival in London in 1967, which I also wrote about. The last time we saw him was in February the 14th, 1970, in a suburb of Paris called Drancy. Charlie was making a tour with Budd Johnson and Oliver Jackson. I was engaged to play the concert with my group and Charlie's group with a French pianist and bassist played the last part of the concert.

Charlie passed away two days after Louis and the music world lost two great jazz men. But thanks to recordings, like some others that left things for them to be remembered by, Louis and Charlie left their music for all to hear and appreciate; May God Bless Charlie Shavers' soul also.
